The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} can either be constructed on the [[graveyard]], or on a [[place for lantern]] in the [[forest near the river]] or near the [[cabin in the woods]]. You need different [[technologies]] for this.

{{PAGENAME}}s automatically ignite at dusk and go off at dawn. They shed some light at the surroundings.

'''Note:''' Those belonging to the [[lantern network]] located in the [[forest near the river|forest]] can not be removed. There are 2 alternative buildings: a [[Torch]] and a [[Wooden lantern]].

{{PAGENAME}}s give static +4 {{Graveyard Rating}} when built on the [[graveyard]]. The maximum of 9 {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}s share the same 9 slots with the {{Item|Flowerbed}}, {{Item|Wooden prayer station}} and {{Item|Stone prayer station}} in the graveyard.

==Notes==
There are only nine locations in the [[graveyard]] where lanterns may be built. There are four locations near the [[cabin in the woods]] and seven [[lantern network|along the path]] leading through the [[forest near the river]].
